description: Na₄Sr(SiO₃)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.93 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.96 Å. Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.63-2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are two shorter (1.61 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. There are two shorter (1.61 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Sr and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sr and two equivalent Si atoms.
